ERASABLE ART: Crayola Erasable Colored Pencils are a great tool for kids. 36 pre-sharpened colored pencils with erasers let kids redo drawings or correct mistakes. Brightly colored lines are perfect for school projects and creating detailed artwork.

### 2. Are Faber-Castell colored pencils erasable?

A lot of people don't realize this, but Faber-Castell offers a small set of Erasable Colored Pencils. These pencils are targeting for children and also come with an attached eraser at the base.

### 3. How do erasable colored pencils work?

Basically the pencils leads are "free of wax or derivatives of wax" that would "resist removal from paper fibers". A lubricant is added to the pencil to make the pencil lead not as hard and easier to lay down on the paper. Crayola also invented a new eraser that would not hurt the surface of the paper.
